retrievalProfile.description: A central oval photographic portrait encased in a tan cardboard-textured border featuring delicate black line-art filigree and Victorian-inspired typography.
excludeWhen: clean digital vector art without texture

recipe.visualDefinition: A central oval window reveals a warm-toned photograph of a man in a waiter's uniform holding a tray of food, surrounded by a wide tan border decorated with thin black scrollwork and corner accents.
coreVisualRelationships: Central oval photograph acting as the focal point
Tan cardboard-textured background providing a neutral frame
Delicate black line-art flourishes framing the oval and corners
Typography overlapping the top and bottom edges of the oval frame

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is centered within a large vertical oval that occupies approximately 60% of the total area.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The man's face and the tray of food are the primary anchors within the oval.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the top display text, moves down to the central portrait, and settles on the bottom subtitle.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample negative space is provided by the wide tan border, which is broken only by thin line-art.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with warm, sepia-adjacent values to evoke a 1970s nostalgic feel.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to earth tones and muted highlights

letterConstructionRules: Top text uses high-contrast, swash-heavy Victorian script with exaggerated terminals
Bottom text uses a heavy, blocky slab serif with a vertical drop shadow
Both styles feature thick black outlines to separate them from the background
characterSpecificRedesigns: Exaggerated descenders and ascenders on the top script
Concave sides on the slab serif stems
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast script paired with heavy geometric slab serif for a kitsch, theatrical look.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab serif for the bottom text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a tan cardboard-textured square frame with a central vertical oval cutout. Inside the oval, place a warm-toned 1970s photograph of a man in a waiter uniform holding a tray. Add delicate black line-art filigree around the oval and in the corners.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add Victorian-style script text at the top center, slightly arched and overlapping the oval. Add a heavy slab-serif title at the bottom center, tilted slightly, with a black drop shadow.

verificationChecks: Does the text overlap the oval edges?
Is the background texture visible as tan cardboard?
Are the line-art flourishes thin and black?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the man
Exact food items on the tray
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the oval frame has a double-line border.
Check that the bottom text has a distinct vertical drop shadow.
Verify the filigree does not obscure the central subject.
Confirm the overall color palette remains in the warm tan/brown spectrum.
recipe.reuseFormula: Central Oval + Cardboard Border + Victorian Filigree + Outlined Display Type = 70s Kitsch Frame
